# Alert dialog

A dialog that interrupts to confirm an action that cannot be undone.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

## See it live

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** Confirms a delete.

- **Use it when:** Deleting, cancelling or overwriting something people cannot get back, when undo is not possible.
- **Not when:** Anything that can be undone (offer undo instead), or a form or task (use a dialog).

Instead:

- [Dialog](./dialog.md): A focused task, not a confirmation.
- [Toast](./toast.md): Undo after the fact, when the action can be reversed.

## How Dense data uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Delete or remove</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Button secondary, then confirm in a dialog with Button danger</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Button primary as the first step</div></div><div class="cap">Deleting is rare and costly; a confirm step catches mistakes.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A confirmation question</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Name the exact object and the consequence</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> &quot;Are you sure?&quot;</div></div><div class="cap">Acting on the wrong record is the costly mistake. Example: “Dismiss 3 alerts? This cannot be undone.”</div></div></div>

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Escape cancels, the same as the safe choice. | undefined |
| undefined | Tab stays inside until people choose. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is an alertdialog with a title and a description that names the consequence. undefined
- [ ] Focus starts on the safe choice, never on the destructive one. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add alert-dialog
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Alert dialog reads 17 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Alert dialog's tokens to change Alert dialog alone.
